correctness.rationale: The global Lyapunov identities are exact for m<0 and m=0; boundedness and LaSalle prove global convergence. The critical linear spectrum is {0,-1,-n}; center-manifold invariance independently yields h(s)=s+s^3/n+(5n+2)s^5/n^3+..., k(s)=s^2/n+(n+2)s^4/n^3+..., and sdot=-s^3/n-[2/n^2+2/n^3]s^5+.... Reciprocal-square differentiation and integrable O(log t/t^2) remainder give 2t/n+(2/n+2/n^2)log t+K+o(1). Exponential stable-fiber tracking extends to all orbits off the global 2D strong stable set; symbolic checker and four numerical integrations were run as diagnostics.

value.rationale: The 2023 source highlights the pitchfork and nonhyperbolic m=0 dynamics without establishing its global fate or physical-time decay. The complete global attraction threshold, dimension of the exceptional rapid-decay set, universal t^{-1/2} and t^{-1} leading constants, and exact nonvanishing positive logarithmic coefficient distinguish genuine critical slowdown from merely local linear nonhyperbolicity. This is a motivated quantification of a recognized bifurcation, not a parameter slice chosen for convenient arithmetic.
